method: Native pinned MiniLM, 384 dimensions, threshold .3, first 500 title/claim characters and 256 tokens, short-query scale 11/12, eight results, 1000/2000 estimated-token budgets reported separately and stable 36-hour claim age. Reuse prior accepted historical baseline artifacts byte-for-byte; build fresh new-case baselines from immutable 60971d7 executable. Select on development and freeze runtime before reserved scoring. Existing exposed and new public-source symbols are not blind agent validation.

extensions.note: Extend saturated symbol and five-fact context groups with new source symbols, three same-title file facts, explicit reference/literal context, and oversized alternatives. Positive counts and record/packet feasibility reported separately; no old fixture or expected claim changed.

safety.requirements: Preserve every previously delivered primary/required claim and required retrieved rank, complete answers, claim identities/hashes; freeze negative returned/rendered/full ID order; no scope/trust/tag/caller violation, fallback or packet/result overrun.

selected_changes: An incumbent canonical title with a claim exceeding the entire known packet budget remains at its original rank but cannot suppress lookup of an additional compact title fact. Existing eligible filtered collection and full protected-packet preview remain authoritative.

Use the specific requested-symbol-title match reason directly for supplemental title additions, rather than appending it to generic BM25 wording. Claim text, evidence, file metadata, scores/components and trust are unchanged.

trials.note: Preserve oversized incumbent and use another unprotected slot for compact fact.
Keep successful existing placement; try earlier slots only after a rejected packet.
Additional bounded placement ordered by displaced record rendered size; removed from final runtime.
Save redundant presentation tokens without trimming a claim or changing packet budget.

validation.broader_tests: Skipped under user instruction. No full crate/core/frontend suite, clippy or final format check run. Changed files formatted.
validation.evaluation: All candidate native policy views passed the committed per-record comparator.

limitations: Synthetic composed queries and exposed public code facts; no new paired real-agent tasks, precision or latency benchmark. Release-quality gate unchanged.
Zero complete-answer recall can include retrieved facts when any requirement is missing; lexical, hybrid, retained old/new corpora and infeasible capacity controls have separate denominators.
Seven/eight required records fit the result ceiling; that alone does not establish packet feasibility at 1000 tokens. Both packet budgets are reported separately.

Oversized incumbents retain ranks and fetch opportunities. Some multi-name/context cases still lack enough unprotected slots; no pruning, wider pools, claim truncation or placement heuristic was accepted.
Supplemental match explanation and positive packet packing can change; every measured required fact/rank and negative packet identity is preserved.
Broader automated tests remain skipped; evaluation preservation is scoped to the replayed corpus.
